frame_panel_review_notes: Supersedes initial connectivity-based rejection: source component 2 contains a modeled U-shaped frame (70 faces) welded to the central leaf relief (296 faces). The existing contour supports a whole-face split with original vertices/UVs retained. The front-only leaf needs an explicitly inferred rear and edge closure; recipe records this reconstruction. No external frame is added.

local_visual_review_notes: Viewed attempt 000002 front/rear RTX captures. Purple frame and decorative front, gold lever, fitted gaps and inferred flat textured rear are intact. Rear repeats source UVs and has no added handle; this documented reconstruction is adequate for pushing.
local_mechanical_review_notes: Attempt 000002 passes static and one isolated RTX 4090 run to the 176-degree geometric limit: three exact resets, stable frame, zero reported penetration. Left hinge is inferred opposite the handle. Source leaf is backed to 53.35 mm final thickness; 0.4% fit leaves jamb clearance. Expert qualification remains pending.
